text:
Nina — Infra Lead: Heads up — marketing expects a Q4 holiday spike. We need a short plan for GPU backfill + reservations across regions. H200 lead times still silly in eu-west. Thoughts on mix H200/H100/L40S for cost vs latency? @Sam @Micah
Sam — Capacity Planner: rough ask: 2M token-hours/day peak over 10 days? that's ~480k GPU-hours on H200, ~620k on H100 (worse perf) — need to sanity check. do we have historical seasonal uplift factor? :thinking:
Micah — Procurement: H200 lead times: quoted 18–24 weeks for reserved racks; H100 spot/short-term availability through partners but constrained in ap-northeast. L40S available in cloud pools; cheaper for batched workloads. We can try to reserve a footprint now but need commit windows. I can push for partial reservation if we lock 3mo.
AJ — SRE: network-wise eu-west has constrained PCIe availability on some racks; mixing GPU types across nodes increases NUMA complexity and scheduling jitter. If we go hybrid, we should isolate H200s for latency-critical routes.
Eli — Runtime: performance-wise H200 gives ~1.6x throughput vs H100 for same batch profile (our perf tests). L40S matches H100 on fp16 for large context but worse for long inference KV cache due to memory. Suggest: H200 for low-latency chat; L40S for batch embeddings / offline rerank.
Kelsey — Finance: ballpark TCO: H200 committed racks have ~40% higher capex but reduce per-token cost by ~25% at high utilization. We need utilization model — if peak is short (10 days) then spot/cloud L40S might be cheaper.
Nina — Infra Lead: good. can we get a cost/latency matrix by Wed? include lead times and region risk (apac eu-west). Micah can you draft reservation ask for 4 racks h200 eu-west and 6 racks h100 us-west as backup?
Micah — Procurement: drafting now. quick ask: do we want multi-region redundancy or single-region for latency? multi-region doubles reservation complexity but gives failover.
Sam — Capacity Planner: I'll simulate the 2M token-hours/day scenario with three mixes: (A) 60% H200 latency, 40% L40S batch; (B) 30% H200, 70% H100; (C) 100% cloud L40S. will drop numbers by EOD.
Nina — Infra Lead: sweet. include "fallback to H100" policy and automated routing rule (prefer h200, fallback h100 then l40s) in the simulation.
deploy-bot: Reservation request created: `resv-2026-q4-backfill` (status: draft)
Eli — Runtime: also flag quantization: if we push int8 on H200 we might lower cost further but need evals — I can run a perf/quality tradeoff on 10 prompts set.
Kelsey — Finance: add a contingency line item for inter-region egress; routing fallback could add 3–6% to costs.
Nina — Infra Lead: awesome. meeting tomorrow 10am to finalize. thanks team :pray:
